overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' ability to perform Bayesian reasoning through simple NLG tasks (coin flips and die rolls). It uses only automatic evaluation (TVD) and does not employ LLM-as-judge or human evaluation. The main contribution is analyzing whether LLM-generated distributions align with Bayesian posterior updates.
